hook: How did you go bankrupt? Two ways: gradually, then suddenly. Wealth works exactly the same way. In this video I break down the 3 money habits behind almost every ordinary millionaire from three angles: the math (savings rate, the crossover point, the cost of a 5-year pause), the psychology of why people quit, and a 30-day setup so the habits run on autopilot.
